Subject: Post-call: Pilot scope & cost targets (token volumes + credits)

Hi Sophie — thanks again for taking the time earlier. Quick written recap from our discovery + the ask for the pilot: 

Summary of customer goals
- Primary use case: search & conversational augmentation in customer support (multi-turn).
- Target quality bar: parity with current heuristic responses for top-10 intents; plan to A/B a reranker after pilot.

Token and budget signals you shared (please confirm if I transcribed correctly)
- Expected pilot burn: ~2M tokens/day (roughly 60M tokens over 30 days).
- Production target (12mo): 800M–1B tokens/month if roll to prod.
- Target unit economics you mentioned: ~$2,500 per 1M tokens (target budget range $1.5k–$3k/1M while evaluating accuracy/cost tradeoffs).

Redwood proposal (high level)
- Hosted trial plan: provide a 30-day pilot with telemetry and token-level cost reporting.
- Suggested pilot credits: $12k–$15k to cover the expected burn and early experimentation.
- Primary eval metrics: token burn rate, avg latency (p95 target < 400ms), and cost per 1M tokens.

Attachments & next steps
- I attached a short pricing estimate workbook (redwood-pricing-estimate-RET-A.xlsx) with two scenarios (hosted vs Dedicated baseline) — please review.
- Next steps: Sophie to confirm pilot burn and procurement constraints; Redwood to confirm credit approval and send a pilot mutual action plan (MAP) + kickoff calendar invite.

If the numbers above look off, flag them and I’ll update. I’ll loop Rishi and Aditya for credit/finance and engineering setup.

Best,
Monica Patel

Thanks Monica — this looks right on scope. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Confirming pilot target: 2M tokens/day (we'll start with a focused support flow and add intents as we validate).
- Our procurement needs a minimum invoice/PO to accept credits. Can Redwood generate a simple statement for the $12k credit plus terms? Our legal asked whether credits expire — we prefer a 60-day window.
- If the pilot moves to production, we expect to negotiate committed capacity (likely Dedicated) in Q4.

Request: can you extend the trial credits to $15k for 30 days? That gives us room for higher burn during load tests. If procurement needs a different format, loop me in and I’ll get them to expedite.

Also happy to do a quick kickoff next Tue afternoon (PDT) after procurement confirms.
